data.name: Vorpal
data.description: This potent and feared ability allows the weapon to sever the heads of those it strikes. Upon a roll of natural 20 (followed by a successful roll to confirm the critical hit), the weapon severs the opponent's head (if it has one) from its body. Certain creature types, including aberrations, oozes, golems, and most undead, are immune to this effect, but most other creatures die when their heads are cut off. A vorpal weapon must be a slashing melee weapon.
